_comment: Machine-readable dependency-license policy. Documentation: dev-docs/info/DEPENDENCY_LICENSE_POLICY.md. Enforced by scripts/check_dependency_licenses.py. Edit accepted_exceptions/overrides here; keep the .md in sync.

pyinstaller.reason: Build-only freezer pinned in requirements-build.txt (not requirements.txt). PyInstaller's GPL carries a special exception permitting proprietary/frozen builds, so its copyleft does not extend to the distributed application. Never imported or bundled as a runtime library.

pyinstaller-hooks-contrib.reason: Build-only hook collection, forced in as a hard transitive dependency of pyinstaller (Requires: pyinstaller-hooks-contrib>=2026.6). Not bundled into the shipped application.
